title: EKS Document Setup Schema - Declarations
description: Document table structure declarations, document/file/element type registries, ontology mapping triggers, revision validation, health scoring configuration, element expectations, and column processing metadata per Appendix B, C & D. v1.9.0: added parsing_profiles property — reusable parser profiles keyed by profile name with capability fields per T1.195 V2. v1.8.0: removed revision_validation and filename_patterns (moved to Project Definition — I265 T1.191). Added filename_profiles as reusable profile-keyed section (T1.191). v1.7.0: added column_processing property — object with column-name keys (DCC-aligned pattern per T1.184 review) for all 42 registry columns (I264, T1.183). v1.6.0: added document_title_config for boilerplate prefix filtering (T1.99.193/I194 G9). v1.5.0: replaced stub file_property_patterns with full schema (os_properties + by_file_type) per Appendix J (T1.99.129). v1.4.0: added filename_patterns + file_property_patterns per Appendix I (T1.99.110). v1.10.0 (I281 T1.223): REMOVED parsing_profiles property — superseded by core eks_setup_schema.json processing_profiles property (one-time migration, Q1). Extraction profile values now live in eks_processing_config.json#/extraction_profiles. Core schemas are the sole profile source. v1.11.0 (I287 T1.241): file_type_registry parser_class REMOVED (single-sourced in extraction_profiles, §16/§24); filename_profiles + file_property_patterns properties now DEPRECATED no-op shapes — values consolidated into eks_processing_config.json (filename_profiles / file_property_profiles / os_properties, T1.239).

ontology_triggers.description: Maps document registry fields to knowledge graph relationship types for Phase 3 ingestion (shared SSOT with asset config)

health_scoring.description: 6-dimension health scoring configuration per Appendix D D7.3-D7.5

weight_tiers.description: Multiplier per column priority tier for extraction confidence scoring

default_source_quality_scores.description: I284: global default cover source-quality map {cover_type: score}. Used by HealthScorer._score_source_quality when a document has no template-scoped source_quality_score.

document_type_registry.description: Canonical registry of document type codes mapped to ontology classes (Appendix C). SSOT definition in eks_document_type_schema.json. Validated against document_type_entry_def in doc base schema.

file_type_registry.description: Canonical registry of file format codes (Appendix B B4/B5). I287 T1.241: parser_class REMOVED — parser implementation is single-sourced in eks_processing_config.json#/extraction_profiles[].parser_class (§16/§24); SchemaLoader validates those against extraction_profile_def.

format_category.description: I279: native vs PDF-print delivery format

element_type_registry.description: Canonical registry of structural element types per Appendix D D7.10 with Phase 2/3 routing metadata.

element_expectations.description: Expected structural elements per template for structural completeness scoring (Appendix D D7.10). Runtime-derived from document_templates (three-section carrier, I279). Keys are template_id values from eks_document_type_schema.json#/document_templates.

document_type_schema_ref.description: I279: URI of the three-section eks_document_type_schema.json carrier that is the single SSOT for document types.

document_templates.description: Runtime-derived template registry (I279) from eks_document_type_schema.json#/document_templates. Keyed by template_id.

filename_profiles.description: DEPRECATED (I287 T1.241): filename parsing profiles moved to eks_processing_config.json#/filename_profiles (core processing_profiles section, T1.239). Retained as no-op shape for schema compatibility only — the doc config no longer carries values.

file_property_patterns.description: DEPRECATED (I287 T1.241): file property extraction moved to eks_processing_config.json#/file_property_profiles + #/os_properties (core processing_profiles section, T1.239). Retained as no-op shape for schema compatibility only — the doc config no longer carries values.

document_title_config.description: Configuration for embedded title extraction quality. Defines boilerplate prefixes that are discarded in favor of filename-derived titles.

boilerplate_prefixes.description: Embedded titles starting with any of these prefixes are treated as boilerplate and discarded.

project_code_titles.description: Runtime-injected mapping of project_code → project_title, loaded from eks_project_code_schema.json by SchemaLoader. Not present in the config file; injected after schema loading.

column_processing.description: Column processing entries keyed by column name. Each entry defines classification, calculation strategy, validation rules, and pipeline phase. DCC-aligned key-as-name pattern per T1.184 review. Schema-driven replacement for hardcoded column logic in pipeline_orchestrator.py / filename_parser.py / _validate_* methods (I264, T1.183).
